notes: gbdraw is a browser-only genome-diagram tool (Vue 3 SPA, no build step; Python rendering runs in a Pyodide Web Worker; LOSAT runs as WASM). Everything, including Pyodide 0.29 and the scientific wheels, is vendored, so it runs fully offline. Setup: mise.toml pins node 26.13.1 (.node-version) and python 3.11.18; .ui-capture/venv has gbdraw installed editable; tools/prepare_browser_wheel.py built gbdraw/web/gbdraw-0.14.5-py3-none-any.whl; .ui-capture/build.sh copies gbdraw/web to .ui-capture/out and adds one <script src=./ui-capture-autoload.js> tag to out/index.html (the repo's source is unchanged). DATA: the app saves nothing between visits (History is in memory), so an established user's state is a saved Session that they reopen. ui-capture-autoload.js (kept out of the app's code) reopens it on page load through the app's own hidden 'Load Session' file input, the same path as clicking Load Session, then presses Fit as 'Load example' does. Add ?blank to the URL to get the empty first-run screen instead. The Session (.ui-capture/data/current.gbdraw-session.json.gz, made by .ui-capture/seed_session.py using gbdraw's own CLI --session_output, session_drawings.write_session_drawings and validate_session; also read without repairs by the web reader readSessionDocument) is a shrimp-virus researcher's working file 'majanivirus_9genomes_LOSATP_groups_v4' with two drawings. Linear (shown first): nine majanivirus genomes (MjeNMV, MelaMJNV, PemoMJNV-A/B, PeseMJNV, LvMJNV, TrcuMJNV, MeenMJNV, MejoMJNV; 280-401 kbp each, hundreds of CDS each) linked by LOSATP similarity groups at >=20% identity, with a custom color table for WSSV-like proteins, BIRP and tyrosine recombinase, a legend on the right, a saved Result and the cached LOSAT results. Circular: a map of MjeNMV (LC738868.1, 306 kbp) with separate strands, outer labels, GC content/skew and the same color tables. Main areas: the header (Load/Save Session, Load example, language, Gallery link); the left settings pane (input files, Circular/Linear mode and drawing, tracks, comparisons/LOSAT, labels, legend, colors/palettes); the central preview canvas (zoom/Fit/pan; click a feature for its popup); the right drawer (feature editor: colors, labels, visibility rules, feature search; legend editor; History); Generate, and export to SVG/PNG/PDF. The 'Load example' menu also lists the 10 local Gallery sessions. Generate and other edits start the in-browser Pyodide worker (all local; the first start takes several seconds). Threaded LOSAT needs COOP/COEP headers, which a plain static server doesn't send; the app falls back to single-threaded LOSAT on its own. Rebuild with: .ui-capture/venv/bin/python .ui-capture/seed_session.py && .ui-capture/build.sh
